title: HVAC Advertising: Getting More Service Calls (2026)

facts.fact: IBISWorld estimates the U.S. HVAC industry generates roughly $31 billion in annual revenue.
facts.quote: The HVAC industry in the U.S. generates roughly [$31 billion in annual revenue]

facts.fact: The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects 6% job growth for HVAC mechanics through 2032.
facts.quote: The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects [6% job growth for HVAC mechanics]

facts.fact: A 2024 BrightLocal survey found 76% of consumers say they "regularly" read online reviews when choosing a local business.
facts.quote: 76% of consumers say they "regularly" read online reviews when choosing a local business

facts.fact: The page states that for most HVAC markets, Google Local Services Ads fees run about $25 to $75 per inquiry; this is the page's own estimate with no cited source.
facts.quote: For most HVAC markets, LSA fees run about $25 to $75 per inquiry.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2024 search benchmarks put average cost per click for HVAC keywords around $15 to $40.
facts.quote: put average cost per click for HVAC terms around $15 to $40

facts.fact: The page gives a planning range of $1,500 to $5,000 per month for combined Local Services Ads and search spend; this is a media budget range, not a booked-job count.
facts.quote: $1,500 to $5,000 per month is a planning range for combined LSA and search spend.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2026 benchmarks show a median $2.18 cost per click for the Home and Home Improvement category on Facebook.
facts.quote: a median $2.18 per click and $42.95 per lead on leads campaigns

facts.fact: The WordStream Facebook figures come from a sample of at least four U.S. campaigns in that category run between April 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026.
facts.quote: from a sample of at least four U.S. campaigns in that category between April 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026.

facts.fact: Sprout Social's 2024 benchmarks show short-form video gets 2.5 times more engagement than static images on Meta platforms.
facts.quote: show short-form video gets 2.5 times more engagement than static images on Meta platforms.

facts.fact: The page is published on 2026-10-05.
Meta ads are planned at $800 to $2,500 a month for ongoing campaigns, according to the page; the page says this is not a CPM or a promised number of calls.
facts.quote: $800 to $2,500 a month is a planning range for ongoing campaigns.

facts.fact: According to a 2024 BrightLocal study cited by the page, 42% of local searchers click on results within the map pack.
facts.quote: 42% of local searchers click on results within the map pack.

facts.fact: According to a 2024 BrightLocal study cited by the page, 87% of consumers read online reviews for local businesses.
facts.quote: 87% of consumers read online reviews for local businesses

facts.fact: Professional local SEO services are priced at $500 to $2,000 per month, while setting up and maintaining a Google Business Profile yourself is free.
facts.quote: Professional local SEO services run $500 to $2,000 per month.

facts.fact: According to a 2023 Yelp Economic Average report cited by the page, home services businesses with complete profiles and 10+ photos received 5 times more customer leads than those without.
facts.quote: received 5 times more customer leads than those without.

facts.fact: Yelp Ads run $300 to $1,000+ per month, while a Yelp profile optimization is free.
facts.quote: Yelp Ads run $300 to $1,000+ per month.

facts.fact: HomeAdvisor/Angi costs $30 to $75 per lead, according to the page.
facts.quote: HomeAdvisor/Angi costs $30 to $75 per lead

facts.fact: Annual spend on HomeAdvisor/Angi often reaches $5,000 to $15,000, according to the page.
facts.quote: with annual spend often reaching $5,000 to $15,000.

facts.fact: EDDM postcards run $0.20 to $0.50 per piece.
facts.quote: EDDM postcards run $0.20 to $0.50 per piece.

facts.fact: A direct mail campaign targeting 10,000 homes costs $2,000 to $5,000 including design and printing, according to the page.
facts.quote: A campaign targeting 10,000 homes costs $2,000 to $5,000 including design and printing.

facts.fact: Door hangers cost $0.10 to $0.25 each, according to the page.
facts.quote: Door hangers cost $0.10 to $0.25 each.

facts.fact: The page recommends leaving door hangers on 10 to 20 neighbors' doors after every service call.
facts.quote: Leave door hangers on 10 to 20 neighbors' doors after every service call.

facts.fact: Adwave media starts at a prepaid daily budget of $30, and at that level the campaign mix includes TV, YouTube and Demand Gen, Google Search, and Facebook and Instagram.
facts.quote: At $30 a day the mix includes TV, YouTube and Demand Gen, Google Search, and Facebook and Instagram.

facts.fact: Adwave's Reddit channel opens at $35.
facts.quote: Reddit opens at $35.

facts.fact: Adwave's TikTok channel runs from $91 once it is turned on and a TikTok account is connected, and it is not in the default channel mix.
facts.quote: TikTok runs from $91 when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account; it isn't in the default mix.

facts.fact: Per Adwave, a month at the $30-per-day floor totals $900 if the campaign runs for 30 days.
facts.quote: A month of that floor is $900 if the campaign stays on for 30 days.

facts.fact: The page gives a planning cost of $1,500 to $5,000 per month for Google Ads / LSAs.
facts.quote: Google Ads / LSAs | $1,500 to $5,000 a month

facts.fact: The page gives a planning cost of $800 to $2,500 per month for Meta / Instagram ads.
facts.quote: Meta / Instagram | $800 to $2,500 a month

facts.fact: The page gives a planning cost of $0 to $2,000 per month for local SEO and Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: Local SEO / GBP | $0 to $2,000 a month

facts.fact: The page states Yelp, HomeAdvisor, and Angi inquiries cost about $30 to $75 each, or a monthly Yelp ads budget.
facts.quote: About $30 to $75 per inquiry, or a monthly Yelp ads budget

facts.fact: The page gives direct mail costs of $0.20 to $0.50 per postcard and $0.10 to $0.25 per door hanger.
facts.quote: $0.20 to $0.50 per postcard, $0.10 to $0.25 per hanger

facts.fact: The page defines the startup phase as a monthly ad budget of $1,500 to $3,000.
facts.quote: Startup phase ($1,500 to $3,000 per month)

facts.fact: The page defines the growth phase as a monthly ad budget of $3,000 to $6,000.
facts.quote: Growth phase ($3,000 to $6,000 per month)

facts.fact: The page defines the established phase as a monthly ad budget of $6,000 or more.
facts.quote: Established phase ($6,000+ per month)

facts.fact: In the startup phase the page allocates 50% of budget to Google Ads / LSAs, which is $750 to $1,500.
facts.quote: Google Ads / LSAs:** 50% of budget ($750-$1,500)

facts.fact: In the startup phase the page allocates 20% of budget to Yelp and lead platforms, which is $300 to $600.
facts.quote: Yelp / lead platforms:** 20% ($300-$600)

facts.fact: In the growth phase the page allocates 15% of budget to TV with Adwave, which is $450 to $900, and states that 15 days at $30 a day is $450 and 30 days is $900.
facts.quote: At $30 a day, 15 days is $450 and 30 days is $900, with Google Search in the same campaign.

facts.fact: In the established phase the page allocates 25% of budget to Google Ads / LSAs, which is $1,500 or more.
facts.quote: Google Ads / LSAs:** 25% ($1,500+)

facts.fact: In the established phase the page allocates 20% of budget to TV / CTV, which is $1,200 or more.
The page recommends increasing the Google Ads budget by 25% to 50% in January through February, when furnace emergencies peak.
facts.quote: Increase Google Ads budget by 25% to 50%.
